text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day off, while taking a walk around town—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ah, found you! Sorry to keep you waiting~♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Shh!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "I am your friend!" Repeat after me, go!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: That's right! So... match my rhythm! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she said that, Haiseiko glanced over at someone holding a camera, glancing around suspiciously.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Come on, friend! Dash, dash! Let's run!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, in order to help Haiseiko shake off the paparazzi, I ended up pretending to be shopping with a good friend.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: How's this? Do I look like a mannequin?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Really? I thought going avant-garde looked much cooler!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, they're coming closer! Quick, Trainer-san, mannequin pose!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. We managed to fool them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, a sudden doubt struck me. The Haiseiko I know is dignified and poised under any circumstance—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "Out in public? It's totally fine to come say hi to me!"

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: "Even so, it's your private life... Wouldn't you want to forget your public persona and relax?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "I don't have a public side or a private side. I'm always just 'Haiseiko'! So please, feel free to call out to me♪"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "Because missing out on everyone's love would be far, far sadder—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For someone like her to want to dodge the paparazzi... Something felt off about this situation—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: This situation kinda reminds me of the past... Back when I retired as an idol.
choice_data_list: Ah... it caused quite an uproar back then, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Haiseiko debuted as an idol, and after active years in show business, made a shocking switch to racing. The announcement took the whole world by storm.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Back then, the paparazzi were unbelievable! Whispering rumors about whether I found a partner, or if I just wanted to go back to being an ordinary horse girl...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Some people even showed up at the academy. I felt so bad for my friends back then... but they all protected me.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I plucked up the courage to make that leap... It brought me so many wonderful encounters.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, what was the reason again?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: The reason you switched to racing.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Because I wanted to run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That smile was so utterly pure and radiant... I found myself completely drawn in.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ah, paparazzi spotted! Let's move. ...Fufu~♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: —Being able to stand on the front lines as an idol again, to the point where paparazzi even come after me...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I could never thank all the fans enough who wished for my return!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Even so, even now... every now and then, I just really get the urge to run. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her reason for wanting to lose the paparazzi... It wasn't standard celebrity avoidance, but something far more innocent—almost too pure of a desire—
choice_data_list: Um... were you just in the mood to run today?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ehe. ...Keep it a secret, okay?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, thanks for tagging along! I feel completely refreshed and satisfied♪ Which means...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Mr. Paparazziii~! If you want an interview, I'll take you on fair and square♪

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: ...Guh?! Wha, ah, huh?! W-Why—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Make sure you get my cute angles, okay~♪ And please help promote the Twinkle Series too while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the paparazzi talked with her, his face gradually morphed into that of an adoring fan... Once again, I witnessed firsthand both her loveliness and her unyielding "strength."
